from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs/task-70114a34.py')
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = []
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            objects.append((color, cells))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    occupied = set()
    for color, cells in sorted(objects, key=lambda obj: max(c for r,c in obj[1]), reverse=True):
        shift = 0
        while True:
            next_shift = shift + 1
            if any(c + next_shift >= w or (r, c + next_shift) in occupied for r,c in cells):
                break
            shift = next_shift
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c+shift] = color
            occupied.add((r,c+shift))
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
